implementation_summary: Added immutable workflow definition and YAML validation; registry-backed named guard/effect capabilities; pure configurable state engine with dynamic options, role and guard results, invalid-edge explanations, cycle boundary; trusted evidence microsecond normalization; config and guard/engine tests including config-only state/edge extension.

tests.reason: Worker protocol assigns all builds and tests to the coordinator; no test or build command was run.

checks.reason: Coordinator-owned verification; worker protocol prohibits executing tests/builds.

decisions: The implementation uses the existing Claim, ClaimFacts, Actor and TransitionCommand domain values and the frozen workflow.yml format.
WorkflowEvidence is an immutable trusted-service input and normalizes all timestamps to PostgreSQL microseconds.
Cycle policy remains the configured request-information transition, informationRequests counter, maximum 3 and exact escalation text.
Effect strategies expose named capabilities as decision identifiers; persistence and dispatch remain outside the pure engine.
risks: Patch has not been compiled or executed; integration and API compatibility remain coordinator verification items.

The loader intentionally accepts only the frozen supported guard/effect/role capability registries; adding new strategy capabilities requires code, while extensions using existing primitives remain YAML-only.
